words: Today's result for the player. In the export, a negative Total P&L means the player lost today.
This month's deposit minus withdraw. Above zero: the player lost this month, so they can get the bonus. Below zero: they withdrew more, so they are profitable and get nothing.
The player's bonus budget. Tier 3 gets 3% of their lifetime P&L, Tier V gets 5%. Bonuses are paid out of this balance.
The sheet where you paste the export and sort Total P&L from lowest to highest, so the biggest losses sit on top.
The TC Member Label for Tier 3 and Tier V players.
The backend system where you check and update player details.

tour.q: Did the player pass every check?
tour.yes: Bonus by the ladder. Admin sends the SMS (pass the username list), you send IM + Push.
tour.no: IM + Push only. No SMS and no bonus mention.

pool.q: The player lost RM 6,000 today but is up RM 3,000 this month. Bonus?
o: No, monthly P&L must be negative
pool.why: Monthly P&L must be negative. A player who is profitable this month gets nothing, even after a loss today.

pool.q: It is 7:05 PM and the report is still loading. What do you do?
o: Wait until the data has fully loaded
pool.why: Do not export before the data has fully loaded. Engage from 8 PM when the data is stable.

pool.q: How do you sort Total P&L to find the top 10?
o: Lowest first, biggest losses on top
pool.why: Sort Total P&L A to Z, lowest first. The biggest losses sit at the top.

pool.q: Today's loss RM 10,000 (ladder RM 118). SW RM 250, so SW x 40% = RM 100. What do you issue?
pool.why: Never above SW x 40%. The highest ladder row at or below RM 100 is RM 98 (the RM 8,000 row).

pool.q: Today's loss is RM 25,000 and SW x 40% is RM 400. What do you issue?
pool.why: RM 21,000 and above is RM 288, the cap of the ladder. It fits under RM 400.

pool.q: The player already claimed today's reward. They are still in the top 10. What now?
A player in the export won RM 2,000 today. Do they get a Top P&L bonus?
o: No, daily P&L must be negative
pool.why: Daily P&L must be negative. A player who won today is skipped.

o: Night shift: export from 7 PM, engage from 8 PM
pool.why: Night shift only. Export and filter from 7 PM; engage from 8 PM once the data is stable.

pool.q: This month the player deposited RM 3,000 and withdrew RM 5,000. They lost RM 4,000 today. Bonus?
o: No: they withdrew more, so they are up this month
pool.why: P&L is deposit minus withdraw. 3,000 minus 5,000 is below zero: the player is profitable this month, so no bonus.

pool.q: A top-10 player fails the checks. What do they get?
o: SMS + IM + Push with the offer
IM + Push only, no bonus mention
pool.why: Not eligible: IM + Push only, no SMS and no bonus mention. SMS is for eligible players only, sent by Admin.

pool.q: You issued the Top P&L bonus. What do you record?
o: Tag Daily P&L Rewarded with the amount and time
pool.why: Tag Daily P&L Rewarded and record the amount and time, then update the QA Record.
